description: Read-only rollout manifest for the Tributary Bot Review Gate staged activation and the Dependabot readiness diagnostic. Secret entries name the credential store only; no secret value belongs in this file or anywhere in the repository.

activation.inactive_behavior: The Bot Review Gate publisher job is skipped before it can request the bot-review-gate-publisher environment or mint an App token. No App-authored check run is published and no merge authority is claimed; if the live main ruleset requires the App-bound Bot Review Gate context, its structural absence blocks merges rather than a workflow-token success being forged.
activation.active_behavior: The publisher requests the protected environment and mints the App token. A missing or wrong credential, binding, or API failure fails the job closed; an explicitly active gate never silently skips.

environment.name: bot-review-gate-publisher
environment.purpose: Scopes the gate-publisher App private key to trusted default-branch deployment only.
environment.deployment_policy: protected branches only (main), no required reviewers

apps.name: tributary-bot-review-gate-publisher
apps.purpose: Publish the App-authored Bot Review Gate check run at the evaluated head.

apps.name: tributary-ruleset-reader
apps.purpose: Read the live main ruleset for the read-only Dependabot readiness diagnostic.
apps.id_source: inside the Dependabot secret store only

variables.name: BOT_REVIEW_GATE_APP_ID
variables.purpose: Bind the required Bot Review Gate context to the gate-publisher App integration id in the live ruleset and in the Dependabot readiness diagnostic. Numeric only; an unset or non-numeric value fails closed.

variables.name: BOT_REVIEW_GATE_ACTIVATION
variables.purpose: The trusted default-off activation flag for staged publication.

rollout_steps: Create the tributary-bot-review-gate-publisher GitHub App with only checks:write, install it, create the bot-review-gate-publisher environment restricted to protected branches (main) with no required reviewers, and store its credentials exclusively as that environment's secrets.
Set the repository variable BOT_REVIEW_GATE_APP_ID to the gate-publisher App's numeric id.
Create the tributary-ruleset-reader GitHub App with only administration:read and store its credentials as Dependabot secrets RULESET_READER_APP_ID and RULESET_READER_APP_PRIVATE_KEY.
Run scripts/preflight_bot_review_gate.sh; expect a staged-inactive, consistent result while activation is off.
Widen ruleset 17650907 to require every context in this manifest with the listed binding and switch on require-conversation-resolution.
Set the repository variable BOT_REVIEW_GATE_ACTIVATION to active and re-run the preflight; expect a validated result.
Validate against a live pull request: confirm every widened check reports, exercise the refresh path, and confirm the gate re-runs green at the same head after the last resolution.
Only then may a separate reviewed change re-introduce Dependabot auto-merge enablement.
